mapper.delete: DELETE FROM prd_patch p USING review_finding f, review_report r WHERE p.source_finding_id = f.id AND f.report_id = r.id AND r.review_job_id = #{reviewId} AND p.status != 'APPLIED'
mapper.update: WITH latest AS ( SELECT r.id, r.overall_score, r.readiness FROM review_job j JOIN review_report r ON r.review_job_id = j.id WHERE j.prd_id = #{prdId} AND j.prd_version_id = #{versionId} AND j.status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE prd_document SET current_score = (SELECT overall_score FROM latest), status = CASE WHEN status = 'ARCHIVED' THEN status WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest) THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_finding f JOIN latest l ON f.report_id = l.id WHERE f.severity IN ('CRITICAL', 'MAJOR')) THEN 'NEED_CHANGES' WHEN (SELECT readiness FROM latest) = 'READY' THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'REVIEWING' END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{prdId} AND current_version_id = #{versionId}
